{{Top|leg}}
'''Snuff''' was an [[Spice/Legends|intoxicant]] that was inhaled through the [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. Varieties included searing [[Alderaanian snuff]], [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]] snuff, and [[snuff-fungus]]. Snuff was frequently kept on a person via a [[snuff box]].
